usedFor: DataBlow Gateway sets up server-side conversion tracking, and “Create Tracking Pipeline” is the step that starts one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Tracking Pipeline” in DataBlow Gateway
bestTemplate.why: A new booking can start a pipeline, so tracking is set up without manual work.

watchOut: Check what a repeated trigger does before you turn it on, since every event runs “Create Tracking Pipeline” again.
